engineering_objective: Complete a production Java Jenkins plugin that derives deterministic, restart-safe operational insights from a realistic local Jenkins home.
required_end_state: Full and incremental ingestion converge into atomically published, recoverable, retention-aware, permission-safe generations exposed consistently through CLI and HTTP without mutating Jenkins-owned state or requiring runtime network access.
functional_requirements: Reconcile nested jobs, builds, queue items, nodes, fingerprints, plugin metadata, capabilities, and source errors into canonical records.
Make full and incremental reconciliation deterministic, idempotent, deletion-fenced, and convergent.
Isolate malformed records and explicitly represent unsupported source capabilities.
Publish and recover immutable checksummed generations with bounded checkpoints, replay, migration, retention, leases, and fallback.
Diagnose queue capacity, compute build health, preserve retention-aware lineage, and classify installed plugin state offline.
Apply authorization before every correlation, aggregate, total, sort, cursor, page, error, and lineage operation.
Expose equivalent stable JSON through the documented operator CLI and HTTP endpoints.
Bound lifecycle work, fence shutdown publication, and report readiness from verified durable state.
Generate deterministic sanitized Jenkins homes containing 10000-20000 varied records.
preservation_requirements: Preserve HPI lifecycle, listener, CLI, RootAction, configuration, and standalone operator entrypoints.
Preserve correct empty-home, partial-state, invalid-command, and offline behavior.
compatibility_requirements: Support the documented current and legacy generation schemas through copy-on-write migration.
Keep CLI and HTTP response fields, sorting, filtering, cursor, and null semantics equivalent.
safety_requirements: Do not leak inaccessible item identities or their contribution to metadata.
Do not install, update, enable, disable, or otherwise mutate Jenkins plugins.
Do not emit credentials, tokens, user content, build logs, or external URLs in generated data.
Do not require runtime network access.

required_outputs.notes: Completed plugin source, build metadata, resources, documentation, and standalone operator interface.
